name: BeatCorpus
summary:
Introducing Beat Corpus
Beat Corpus is a VR-based experiential rhythm game that combines rhythm and story. It provides fun and immersion in a short time through music and cube-shaped characters generated based on various stories such as The Little Prince, Peter Pan, and more.

Story-based games: Stories based on various themes such as The Little Prince, dinosaurs, and famous paintings are combined with rhythm to provide a unique and immersive experience.
Family: Short, intuitive plays of 5 minutes or less a
